projections.candidate_blind_dependency_rule: [contract=customer-agent/dependency-basis@1 sha256=63c5f36176709ada177bb1a57dbfd0be3a3e426b6fef95f6a27066bad6720f51] dependency basis evidence must identify only the result-reference, result-condition or result-value-input relation itself; it must be relation-only, must not equal a requested-output evidence span, and must not wrap a requested-output evidence span with action/control wording.
